versions.changelog:
academic-celebrities v1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive role skill bank featuring 159 major academic figures across 17 disciplines.
- Each figure includes 4 standardized files (SKILL, data, requirements, dialogue), totaling 636 files.
- Organized by discipline (three historical layers) and chronological order within each field.
- Easy-to-use trigger keywords: 学术名人, 学术角色, 学者角色, academic celebrity, 学者Skill, character-builder.
- Complete Chinese-English index covering philosophy, history, mathematics, science, arts, humanities, and modern disciplines.
